snippet.title: Blood Invasion: Vampire RPG
snippet.description:
https://say.games/en?utm_source=social&utm_placement=yt

The ultimate vampire survival rpg awaits you, so download Blood Invasion today and get to hunting! This game centers on you, the vampire, as you set out to remind those silly humans that the legends and tales they like to tell are based on truth. Collect their blood and turn it into power as you explore dungeons and castles, but beware the vampire hunters who are out for YOUR blood! With cute graphics and lots of excitement, you won’t want to miss out!
